title: Ten Ways NAS Is Getting Enshitified
summary: This article critiques the declining quality and user experience of Network-Attached Storage (NAS) products, highlighting trends like proprietary lock-in, subscription creep, and reduced hardware repairability. It argues that vendors are prioritizing profit over consumer control, leading to 'enshittification' of a once-open technology space. The discussion on Hacker News reflects broader concerns about tech industry practices.
